title: Recruitment workflow labels
summary: Recruitment application status, role status and role category labels now come from the shared terms in Title Case.
changes: Application statuses on public and staff Recruitment screens use the shared terms, so Under review now reads Under Review.
Staff role lists, details and filters show Title Case role status and category instead of stored values.
Remove three duplicated application status label maps.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.43 line: display labels only, with no data, transition, validation or permission change.
validation: RecruitmentWorkflowLabelsTest covers public and staff status, category and role status labels.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Recruitment decision emails keep their existing per-status wording.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
